'''Meursault''' is Sinner #5 of Limbus Company's LCB department. His literary source is Albert Camus's ''The Stranger''. He is the focus character of [[Canto X]]: The Gaze Bearing.

== Personality ==
Meursault is blunt, reserved and obedient, and prefers clear orders that leave no judgement to him. He notices details others miss but often struggles to decide which ones matter, and he slowly learns to share his thoughts and act on his own.

== Background ==
Before joining Limbus Company, Meursault worked for N Corp. at the [[Grand Magasin Sisyphe]] in District 14. He was exiled from the District after killing his mother, a Sisyphean Giant who had Distorted and asked him to free her. [[Jeanne]], another Giant, is his former lover.

== Story ==
At the end of [[Intervallo VII: Mnestic Experience]], N Corp. arrests him for returning to District 14. In [[Canto X]]: The Gaze Bearing, he is sentenced, sent into the Sisyphe, and finally pries its Golden Bough from Jeanne's Distorted body.
